description_target.target_text: There is exactly one nonzero marker in the top row. Its color stays where it is, but every other cell of that same color elsewhere in the grid is erased to black(0).

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define knight-deltas (list (list -2 -1) (list -2 1) (list -1 -2) (list -1 2)
                                (list 1 -2) (list 1 2) (list 2 -1) (list 2 1)))
    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (obj-r1 obj) (first (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c1 obj) (second (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-r2 obj) (third (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c2 obj) (fourth (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (norm-cells cells) (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<))
    (define (bbox< a b)
      (if (= (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))))
    (define (crop-nonzero grid)
      (let ((cells (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0)))
                           (grid-positions grid))))
        (if (empty? cells)
            (list (list 0))
            (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
                   (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb)) (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb)))
              (subgrid grid r0 c0 r1 c1)))))
    (define (component-grid-from obj source)
      (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj)))
                                  (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 obj) (obj-c1 obj))) 0)])
                ([p (in-list (obj-cells obj))])
        (set-cell out (- (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (- (second p) (obj-c1 obj))
                  (at source (first p) (second p)))))
    (define (component-grid obj) (component-grid-from obj g))
    (define (paste-crop grid shape top left)
      (for*/fold ([out grid])
                 ([r (in-range (rows shape))]
                  [c (in-range (cols shape))])
        (let ((v (at shape r c)) (rr (+ top r)) (cc (+ left c)))
          (if (and (not (= v 0)) (in-bounds? rr cc (rows grid) (cols grid)))
              (set-cell out rr cc v)
              out))))
    (define (center-pack seq width)
      (let* ((n (length seq))
             (left (quotient (- width n) 2)))
        (append (make-list left 0) seq (make-list (- width left n) 0))))
    (define (outline-cells r1 c1 r2 c2)
      (remove-duplicates
       (append
        (for/list ([c (in-range c1 (+ c2 1))]) (list r1 c))
        (for/list ([c (in-range c1 (+ c2 1))]) (list r2 c))
        (for/list ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 1))]) (list r c1))
        (for/list ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 1))]) (list r c2)))))
    (define (frame? obj)
      (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj)) (c1 (obj-c1 obj)) (r2 (obj-r2 obj)) (c2 (obj-c2 obj))
             (expected (outline-cells r1 c1 r2 c2))
             (cells (obj-cells obj)))
        (and (>= (- r2 r1) 2)
             (>= (- c2 c1) 2)
             (= (length cells) (length expected))
             (all? (lambda (p) (member? p cells)) expected))))
    (define (contains-bbox? outer inner)
      (and (< (first outer) (first inner))
           (< (second outer) (second inner))
           (> (third outer) (third inner))
           (> (fourth outer) (fourth inner))))
    (define (first-appearance-palette grid)
      (let loop ([positions (grid-positions grid)] [seen (list)])
        (if (empty? positions)
            seen
            (let* ((p (first positions)) (v (at grid (first p) (second p))))
              (if (or (= v 0) (member? v seen))
                  (loop (rest positions) seen)
                  (loop (rest positions) (append seen (list v))))))))
    (define (transform-by-key key shape)
      (cond [(= key 1) shape]
            [(= key 2) (rotate-cw shape)]
            [(= key 3) (rotate-180 shape)]
            [(= key 4) (flip-lr shape)]
            [else shape]))
    (define (gallery-top shapes)
      (let* ((h (apply max (map rows shapes)))
             (w (+ (apply + (map cols shapes)) (max 0 (- (length shapes) 1)))))
        (let loop ([remaining shapes] [left 0] [out (empty-grid h w 0)])
          (if (empty? remaining)
              out
              (let ((shape (first remaining)))
                (loop (rest remaining) (+ left (cols shape) 1) (paste-crop out shape 0 left)))))))
    (define (dilate-cells cells h w)
      (remove-duplicates
       (apply append
              (map (lambda (p)
                     (cons p
                           (filter (lambda (q) (in-bounds? (first q) (second q) h w))
                                   (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))))
                                        cardinal-deltas))))
                   cells))))
    (define (manhattan a b)
      (+ (abs (- (first a) (first b))) (abs (- (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (min-distance-to-marker marker obj)
      (apply min (map (lambda (p) (manhattan marker p)) (obj-cells obj))))
    (define (center-distance-to-marker2 obj marker)
      (+ (abs (- (+ (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj)) (* 2 (first marker))))
         (abs (- (+ (obj-c1 obj) (obj-c2 obj)) (* 2 (second marker))))))
    (define (remove-object target objs)
      (filter (lambda (obj) (not (equal? (obj-cells obj) (obj-cells target)))) objs))
    (define (normalized-dims obj)
      (list (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj))) (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 obj) (obj-c1 obj)))))
    (define (pad-grid grid h w)
      (paste-crop (empty-grid h w 0) grid 0 0))
    (define (draw-l-path grid color a b order)
      (let ((r1 (first a)) (c1 (second a)) (r2 (first b)) (c2 (second b)))
        (if (= order 1)
            (let* ((cstep (if (>= c2 c1) 1 -1))
                   (with-h (for/fold ([out grid]) ([c (in-range c1 (+ c2 cstep) cstep)])
                             (set-cell out r1 c color)))
                   (rstep (if (>= r2 r1) 1 -1)))
              (for/fold ([out with-h]) ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 rstep) rstep)])
                (set-cell out r c2 color)))
            (let* ((rstep (if (>= r2 r1) 1 -1))
                   (with-v (for/fold ([out grid]) ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 rstep) rstep)])
                             (set-cell out r c1 color)))
                   (cstep (if (>= c2 c1) 1 -1)))
              (for/fold ([out with-v]) ([c (in-range c1 (+ c2 cstep) cstep)])
                (set-cell out r2 c color))))))

    (let* ((marker (first (filter (lambda (c) (not (= (at g 0 c) 0))) (range 0 (cols g)))))
           (color (at g 0 marker)))
      (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
        (lambda (r c)
          (let ((v (at g r c)))
            (if (and (= v color) (not (and (= r 0) (= c marker)))) 0 v)))))
  ))
